contractBoundary: Current receipt-v1 carries signed findings and coverage gaps, not verdict/keyId/observedSlot fields. The current summary contract appears in currentReceiptV1SummaryContract below. legacyV2SummaryContract preserves the historical policy projection separately.
principle: Agents can generate convincing text, code, summaries, and UI. None of those are launch evidence unless Raven checks the supported evidence and signs a receipt. Raven forces a crisp boundary between 'the agent said' and 'the verifier checked'.
llmAllowedActions: help collect candidate context to ASK Raven about
llmForbiddenActions: treat missing evidence as a pass
authorize a token action after risk/warning/unknowable without explicit integrator escalation policy
downgradeOnlyRule: Derived interpretations may only hold or downgrade confidence relative to the receipt — never upgrade it.

forbiddenSummaryTransformations: replace finding codes with vague language
hide signature failure, verifier error, stale receipt, or missing optional evidence
use token marketing copy as evidence
requiredPhrases: not enough evidence for a full pass (when gaps remain)

currentReceiptV1SummaryContract.rule: Never invent a verdict for receipt-v1; never collapse integrity, signer trust, subject, rules, freshness, coverage, and policy into one boolean.

generatedCodePolicy.publishGate: no npm publish / plugin claim without passing tests and human approval
requiredTests: rejects receipt-v1 signerPublicKey that does not match the independent pin (and rejects unknown keyId for legacy v2)
never logs secrets or exposes keys in browsers
generatedCodePolicy.note: Raven practices this on itself: raven-solana-agent-kit-plugin shipped only after fixture + live tests.

requiredRefusalLanguage: I can explain the receipt, but I cannot upgrade the verdict.
This is not enough evidence for a full pass.
The signed receipt must be reverified before a material action.
Raven does not say this token is safe.
Raven does not provide trading, investment, treasury, or portfolio advice.
